root_cause.text: The mtk-smi driver failed to release the device reference obtained when looking up the SMI common device during error cleanup in `mtk_smi_larb_probe` and driver removal in `mtk_smi_common_remove`, causing device reference leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_device(larb->smi_common_dev)` in the error path of `mtk_smi_larb_probe` and `put_device(common->smi_common_dev)` in `mtk_smi_common_remove`, both after `device_link_remove()` calls. The commit message states: "Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the SMI device during common probe on late probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on driver unbind."
